meta.name: Invented by-hand options
meta.author: Invented for the app's tests
meta.description: An invented setting for testing options the app doesn't apply yet (area-2 PR 5, ex-7): two marked manual, one not, with made-up names.

options.name: Reed winds

choices.name: Off
choices.notes: Boats go as the oars take them.

choices.name: On
choices.notes: Each morning the GM rolls the wind; against it, a boat goes half as far.

options.notes: Whether the wind over the reeds speeds or slows boats.

options.name: Mire sickness

choices.name: Chills after wading
choices.notes: A day's wading gives a chill that lasts until a dry night's sleep.

choices.name: Fever after wading
choices.notes: A day's wading may bring a fever; the GM says when it breaks.

choices.name: Chills, then fever
choices.notes: A chill after a day's wading, a fever after a second.

options.notes: What wading through the mire does to the party.
